visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a beige oversized hoodie and white shorts, sits on a brown sofa in a modern indoor setting. She stares intensely at a smartphone in her hands with a nervous, tensed facial expression, including squinted eyes and a tight mouth. (2) She reacts with sudden shock, opening her mouth wide and gesturing wildly as she looks at the phone screen. Her movements are rapid as she brings the phone close to her face then pulls it away in disbelief. (3) She leans toward a silver laptop on a white round table. After looking at the screen, she immediately covers her face with both hands, beginning to sob and laugh. The room background features a brown upright piano and white storage walls. (4) A close-up shot of the laptop screen displays a list of award nominees. She points her index finger at the name '江宇婷' (Chiang Yu-ting). Her hands are trembling slightly as she touches the screen. (5) She stands up and moves around the apartment, which has a bright, airy feel with white curtains. She raises her arms above her head, jumping and spinning in a celebratory manner while continuing to cry with joy. (6) She walks toward a balcony window, pulling back a white sheer curtain. She looks out over an urban street with parked scooters, then turns back to the camera with a tear-streaked but ecstatic face, waving her hands in the air.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo acoustic guitar and driving drums BGM sets an energetic mood. The woman's voice is tight and breathless, emitting sharp gasps and soft whimpers of anxiety. (2) A sudden, deafening shriek of high-pitched joy (transient peak) marks the discovery. This is followed by rapid, high-arousal speech with a shaky, emotional timbre. (3) The audio texture shifts to include loud sobbing and hysterical laughter, exhibiting extreme pitch variability. (4) The background sound of a professional male announcer's voice from a laptop broadcast cuts in, announcing names with clear, lower-pitched resonance. (5) Multiple people in the background burst into loud cheering and clapping, creating a chaotic but joyful acoustic atmosphere. The woman shouts 'Thank you' repeatedly with a strained but ecstatic vocal quality. (6) A final loud, triumphant shout from the woman is captured with significant reverb as she moves toward an open balcony, concluding with high-intensity laughter.
